thread.title: Second Amendment Restoration Act receives support from major gun rights groups, Rep. Wesley Hunt says
thread.title_full: Second Amendment Restoration Act receives support from major gun rights groups, Rep. Wesley Hunt says

author: NW Houston News
title: Second Amendment Restoration Act receives support from major gun rights groups, Rep. Wesley Hunt says
text:
Rep. Wesley Hunt’s Press Office announced on November 12, 2025, that the Second Amendment Restoration Act has received endorsements from several prominent gun rights organizations.
In a post dated November 12, 2025, the office stated: “The Second Amendment Restoration Act is endorsed by:
Gun Owners of America (GOA)
National Association for Gun Rights (NAGR)
Texas Gun Rights Association (TXGR)
Texas State Rifle Association (TSRA)
The National Rifle Association (NRA)”
Another message posted the same day at 16:15 UTC included references to several congressional representatives and gun rights groups, along with a link for further information: @RepTroyNehls @Rep_Clyde @RepBrandonGill @RepChipRoy @RepGosar @RepJohnRose @RepDonaldsPress @RepBarryMoore @NRA @GunOwners @gunrights @TXGunRights @TSRA_outreach READ MORE: https://t.co/bvlUYQzuKc
Later, at 17:35 UTC on November 12, the press office acknowledged additional support from another lawmaker: @RepTroyNehls @Rep_Clyde @RepBrandonGill @RepChipRoy @RepGosar @RepJohnRose @RepDonaldsPress @RepBarryMoore @NRA @GunOwners @gunrights @TXGunRights @TSRA_outreach Special thanks to @RepMikeCollins for also joining the effort!
Wesley Hunt has served as the U.S. Representative for Texas’s 38th District since 2023. He was born in Houston in 1981 and continues to reside there. Hunt won his seat in Congress after defeating Duncan Klussmann in the 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2024 by defeating Melissa McDonough.
